integrity: The proof uses the false-twin lower bound, identifies the collision preventing a q-1-set from resolving, and classifies all q-vertex candidates. The standalone verifier reconstructs distances and tests every subset directly.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to broom trees with at least three brush leaves and handle length at least two.
The two-brush-leaf case has a different minimum-basis classification and is not included.
No claim is made for arbitrary caterpillars or general trees.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= q <= 7 and 2 <= ell <= 8 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed treatment of the same broom family.
title: Outer multiset dimension and all bases of broom trees
